body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Nokia unveiled the highly anticipated mobile computer 'N97' during CES 2009, which has been repeatedly commended as one of the most stylish, functional and impressive converged mobile devices to date.
